text: A demonstration was planned to be held on 12 March 2011 in Baku.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 7 March 2011, prior to the assembly, the organisers of the demonstration gave notice to the Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The organisers of the demonstration were members of the opposition.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA) refused to authorise the demonstration at the place indicated by the organisers.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA) proposed a different location for the demonstration on the outskirts of Baku — the grounds of a driving school situated in the 20th habitable area of the Sabail District.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The organisers decided to hold the demonstration in the centre of Baku despite the Baku City Executive Authority's refusal to authorise the originally indicated location.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the applicant, the demonstration was intended to be peaceful.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the applicant, the demonstration was conducted in a peaceful manner.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The participants of the demonstration were protesting against, inter alia, corruption.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The participants of the demonstration were demanding the resignation of the President of the State.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant attended the demonstration on 12 March 2011 in Baku.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Shortly after the demonstration had begun, the police started to disperse those who had gathered.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was arrested during the police dispersal operation.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: After his arrest, the applicant was taken to three different police stations consecutively.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the applicant, he was arrested at around 2 p.m. on 12 March 2011.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's arrest and custody in the police stations were video recorded on a mobile phone by one of the protesters, Mr A.H.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On the day of the applicant's arrest, an administrative-offence report (inzibati xəta haqqında protokol) was drawn up in respect of the applicant by police officer E.G.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The administrative-offence report stated that at around 2.55 p.m. on 12 March 2011, at Fountains Square in Baku, the applicant had attempted to hold an unlawful demonstration.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The administrative-offence report stated that the applicant had disobeyed a lawful order of a police officer.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences (violation of the rules on holding public assemblies).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (failure to comply with a lawful order of a police officer).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 12 March 2011, two police officers, M.A. and H.A., prepared a report (raport) for a superior.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The report prepared by police officers M.A. and H.A. stated that at around 4 p.m. during the demonstration they had arrested ten individuals.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The report prepared by police officers M.A. and H.A. contained a list of the arrested protesters.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the applicant, his name — the eleventh on the list in the report prepared by police officers M.A. and H.A. — was added to the report later in different handwriting.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the official records, the administrative-offence report in the applicant's respect was prepared on the basis of the report drawn up by police officers M.A. and H.A.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the material time, Article 410.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that an individual who is subject to administrative-offence proceedings or a representative of a legal entity shall be given an opportunity to familiarise himself with the administrative-offence report.
section_path: II. RELEVANT DOMESTIC LAW AND INTERNATIONAL DOCUMENTS

text: At the material time, Article 410.4 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that an individual who is subject to administrative-offence proceedings or a representative of a legal entity has the right to a copy of the administrative-offence report.
section_path: II. RELEVANT DOMESTIC LAW AND INTERNATIONAL DOCUMENTS

text: At the material time, Article 437.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision in an administrative-offence case shall be given to the individual with respect to whom the decision was adopted within three days of its adoption.
section_path: II. RELEVANT DOMESTIC LAW AND INTERNATIONAL DOCUMENTS

text: At the material time, Article 437.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision sentencing an individual to administrative detention shall be given to that individual on the day of its adoption.
